description: Unit test class for the Basket entity, focusing on the AddItem method behavior in the eShopOnWeb application's core domain.

classes.name: BasketAddItem
classes.description: Unit test suite for testing the AddItem method of the Basket class.

methods.name: AddsBasketItemIfNotPresent
methods.description: Tests that a new item is added to the basket when it is not already present.

methods.name: IncrementsQuantityOfItemIfPresent
methods.description: Tests that adding an existing item increases its quantity.

methods.name: KeepsOriginalUnitPriceIfMoreItemsAdded
methods.description: Ensures that the unit price remains unchanged when additional quantities are added.

methods.name: DefaultsToQuantityOfOne
methods.description: Checks that adding an item without specifying quantity defaults to 1.

methods.name: CantAddItemWithNegativeQuantity
methods.description: Verifies that attempting to add an item with negative quantity throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException.

methods.name: CantModifyQuantityToNegativeNumber
methods.description: Checks that adding an item with negative quantity after initial addition throws ArgumentOutOfRangeException.
